description: This file contains utility classes and functions for quantized modules in PyTorch, including a base class for quantized modules, weight clamping, quantization functions, and helper functions for parameter handling.

classes.name: WeightedQuantizedModule
classes.description: Wrapper for quantized modules that can be lowered from reference modules.

methods.name: from_reference
methods.description: Abstract method to create a module from a reference module, output scale, and zero point.
